entries.answer: Please check your MAYA from time to time and application processing will take 4 - 8 weeks. All successful applicants will be notified via MAYA.

entries.question: What documents are required for application?
entries.answer: A complete online application should have: Recent passport-size photographs with a blue background; Certified copies of passport (first page only - photo, owner details and validity)/ Identity Card; Certified copies of Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM), academic certificate with detailed academic transcripts/results for Higher School Certificate (HSC) , Grade 12 or GCE (A' Level) or Diploma from recognized Institutions. Official translation is needed for applicants whose native language is not English or Malay; Certified copies of TOEFL/IELTS or other equivalent examinations indicating English proficiency (if available); A letter of guarantee from the sponsor for sponsored students;

entries.question: The typical challenges students face during the programme.
entries.answer: One of the biggest challenges part-time students face is time management. Balancing work, personal commitments, and academic workload can be demanding. The coursework involves assignments, readings, and projects that require consistent effort. It’s important to plan your schedule well and pace your learning.
entries.source_text: 24 The typical challenges students face during the programme. One of the biggest challenges part-time students face is time management. Balancing work, personal commitments, and academic workload can be demanding. The coursework involves assignments, readings, and projects that require consistent effort. It’s important to plan your schedule well and pace your learning.

entries.question: The kind of technical readiness (e.g. programming, math, machine learning) expected at the start of Master of Artificial Intelligence
entries.answer: A basic foundation in programming (preferably Python) and comfort with mathematics (linear algebra, probability, and calculus) is important. Students without this background tend to struggle more initially, but it’s possible to catch up with dedication and the right resources.

entries.question: Whether there is academic or peer support available for students who may need additional help,
entries.answer: Yes, there is both academic and peer support. Lecturers are approachable. Students also form study groups and online communities to support each other. Additionally, there are plenty of open-access learning materials and recommended resources for those who may need to strengthen their technical foundations.

entries.question: And any advice you might have for prospective students to prepare in advance for Master of Artificial intelligence
entries.answer: Learn basic Python programming through free platforms, review math for machine learning (there are many beginner-friendly resources available), explore introductory AI or ML courses, such as Andrew Ng’s course on Coursera.

entries.question: The typical challenges students face during the programme.
entries.answer: One of the biggest challenges part-time students face is time management. Balancing work, personal commitments, and academic workload can be demanding. The coursework involves assignments, readings, and projects that require consistent effort. It’s important to plan your schedule well and pace your learning.

entries.question: The kind of technical readiness (e.g. programming, math, machine learning) expected at the start of Master of Artificial Intelligence
entries.answer: A basic foundation in programming (preferably Python) and comfort with mathematics (linear algebra, probability, and calculus) is important. Students without this background tend to struggle more initially, but it’s possible to catch up with dedication and the right resources.

entries.question: As shown in the the MAYA portal indicates that my status is “Ready to Enrol". However, it also states that the enrollment/registration period is closed. May I ask why this is happening? Did I miss the enrollment period or should I wait until orientation week to proceed with the next steps?
entries.answer: The status "Ready to Enrol" is automatically generated for all students who accept the offer letter. You must register in early September and pay all the fees by early October (before the class starts). Then, the status will change to "Active."
